title: Kiritani Haruka — Expressing "Who We Are"〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhum♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You sound like you're in a good mood, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because I can't wait for our design competition!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. When I get home later, I'm gonna go over all the outfits I've drawn up until now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You mentioned that you drew outfits that you always wanted to wear in your notebook for when you did become an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She did. Winning this competition isn't going to be easy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. But that doesn't mean we're letting you walk away with this. I'm at least gonna give it everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. I'll need to do my best to stay competitive.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Since we're all participating, it might be good to make sure we don't all land on the same idea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
Do we all know what we're gonna do?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm sorry.
I can't say that I do yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My plan is to use my old Cheerful * Days outfits as reference and see where I can go from there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My goal's to cram all the things I love into my design!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And we'd expect no less from you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In that case, I think I'll go for something more standard. Something that screams, “I'm an idol!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I think I'll try designing something that can handle tough dance routines...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It might be nice since we've all improved so much as dancers since starting our group.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, sounds like we shouldn't end up with anything too similar.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Let's give designing these outfits our best shot.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As for the skirt... The hemline can be at about the knees.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's meant to look good while dancing, so I need it to flow somehow... What if I did this...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hmm... Getting what I'm imagining onto a sheet of paper is harder than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The outfits we wore when I was still in ASRUN were almost all designed with specific songs in mind.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They were more meant to match a song's theme as opposed to being “ASRUN outfits”...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (In return, they included designs that made it clear they were a part of a song's story or lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's it.
Something that tells a story...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I want to tell the story of who we are. I want to tell everyone about how we came to be MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But how do I do that...?
How do I tell the story of MORE MORE JUMP!...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been through so much together...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Looking back... Meeting Minori on the rooftop that day might've been the start of something really special.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our school's rooftop...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (On top of being idols, we're high schoolers.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have a feeling that being around the same age as our fans coupled with who we are as a group means we have something genuine to offer.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go with something that looks like a school uniform...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, I want it to give us the mobility to take on any dance...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's like I know what I'm doing all of a sudden. I should ride this wave and knock out my first draft!
